name: PieChart.data
description: Data array - each item represents a slice

name: PieChart.size
description: Chart size in pixels. If not provided, uses parent container size

name: PieChart.innerRadius
description: Inner radius for donut charts. Default: 0 (solid pie)

name: PieChart.padAngle
description: Padding angle between slices in radians. Default: 0

name: PieChart.cornerRadius
description: Corner radius for rounded slice edges. Default: 0

name: PieChart.startAngle
description: Start angle in radians. Default: -PI/2 (top)

name: PieChart.endAngle
description: End angle in radians. Default: 3*PI/2 (full circle from top)

name: PieChart.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: PieChart.hoveredIndex
description: Controlled hover state - index of hovered slice

name: PieChart.onHoverChange
description: Callback when hover state changes

name: PieChart.hoverOffset
description:
Hover offset in pixels for slice hover effects.
This also determines the padding around the chart to prevent clipping.
Default: 10

name: PieChart.children
description: Child components (PieSlice, PieCenter, patterns, gradients, etc.)

name: PieChart.enterTransition
description: Framer Motion transition for slice enter animation

name: PieChart.enterStaggerScale
description: Scales slice stagger delays (1 = default).

name: PieChart.geometryScrubbing
description:
High-frequency geometry updates (e.g. studio NumberField scrub).
Uses plain SVG paths instead of Motion `d` / spring hover morphing.

name: PieSlice.index
description: Index of the slice in the data array

name: PieSlice.color
description: Optional color override - falls back to data color or palette

name: PieSlice.fill
description: Optional fill override for patterns/gradients (e.g., "url(#patternId)")

name: PieSlice.animate
description: Animate the slice on mount. Default: true

name: PieSlice.showGlow
description: Show glow effect on hover. Default: true

name: PieSlice.hoverEffect
description:
Hover effect type. Default: "translate"
- "translate": Slice moves outward along its radial axis
- "grow": Slice extends its outer radius (gets longer)
- "none": No hover animation

name: PieSlice.hoverOffset
description: Distance in pixels for hover effect (translate distance or grow amount). Defaults to PieChart's hoverOffset

name: PieSlice.className
description: Additional CSS class

name: PieCenter.defaultLabel
description: Label shown below the value. Default: "Total" when not hovering

name: PieCenter.formatOptions
description: Format options for NumberFlow. Default: standard notation

name: PieCenter.children
type: (props: { value: number; label: string; isHovered: boolean; data: { label: string; value: number; color?: string; fill?: string }; }) => ReactNode
description: Custom renderer for idle and hover states. Idle data contains the total and defaultLabel.

name: PieCenter.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: PieCenter.valueClassName
description: Class name for the value text. Scales with center size via container queries.

name: PieCenter.labelClassName
description: Class name for the label text. Scales with center size via container queries.

name: PieCenter.prefix
description: Prefix to show before the number (e.g., "$")

name: PieCenter.suffix
description: Suffix to show after the number (e.g., "%")

name: PieCenterShell.defaultLabel
description: Label shown below the value. Default: "Total" when not hovering

name: PieCenterShell.formatOptions
description: Format options for NumberFlow. Default: standard notation

name: PieCenterShell.className
description: Additional class name for the container

name: PieCenterShell.valueClassName
description: Class name for the value text. Scales with center size via container queries.

name: PieCenterShell.labelClassName
description: Class name for the label text. Scales with center size via container queries.

name: PieCenterShell.prefix
description: Prefix to show before the number (e.g., "$")

name: PieCenterShell.suffix
description: Suffix to show after the number (e.g., "%")

name: PieCenterShell.centerValue
description: Value shown with NumberFlow (same role as pie total when not hovering)

name: PieCenterShell.contextSize
description: Square reference size for pie context (matches `PieChart` `size`)

name: PieCenterShell.innerRadiusPx
description: Inner radius in px — must be > 0 so `PieCenter` renders

name: PieCenterShell.animateEntrance
description:
When true (default), the first paint uses `0` then updates to `centerValue`
on the next frame so NumberFlow can run an entrance transition. Subsequent
`centerValue` updates animate as usual.

name: ChartStatFlow.value
description: Required composition API.

description: Required composition API.
